name: D. Очередь черновика
description: Ручной отбор возможностей approved_for_drafting без черновика. Ставит jobs.type = draft. Узла отправки нет.

parameters.content:
## Только постановка черновика в очередь
Берутся `opportunities.status = approved_for_drafting`, для которых нет строки в `drafts`.

Вставляется `jobs.type = draft`, `jobs.status = pending`.
Письмо, Telegram и webhook не отправляются.

parameters.query:
SELECT o.id AS opportunity_id, o.company_id
FROM opportunities o
WHERE o.status = 'approved_for_drafting'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM drafts d
    WHERE d.opportunity_id = o.id
  )
ORDER BY o.id ASC;

INSERT INTO jobs (company_id, opportunity_id, type, status)
SELECT $1::bigint, $2::bigint, 'draft', 'pending'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM jobs
  WHERE opportunity_id = $2::bigint
    AND type = 'draft'
    AND status = 'pending'
)
RETURNING id, company_id, opportunity_id, type, status;
